A '''mission''' was launched by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to infiltrate and destroy the ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'', a powerful [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] capable of destroying multiple [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team, comprised of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jyl Somtay]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was sent to destroy it, but they were caught in a trap set by Admiral [[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]] who lured then onto a [[Starcrusher (decoy)|decoy ship]] and sent them on a course into a star. Admiral himself left in an escape pod, waiting for the real Starcrusher to arrive. Right after the arrival of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who cut short his mission to [[Daltarri]] the real Starcrusher appeared. Thanks to the help of Lieutenant [[Daan (Human)|Daan]] who was abandoned in the decoy ship by Admiral Kirst, Anakin was able to disable the power generator of the Starcrusher, while Obi-Wan and the rest of the Jedi strike team, activated a magnetization of their ship's hull causing the two Starcrushers to collide. Skywalker then picked up the Jedi and the separatist Lieutenant and called for transport.
The separatist battleship launch escape pods but it was too late as they were all pulled by the gravitational field of the star.
